title: Positional encodings of integers in one value set
description: x = a0 + B (a1 + B (a2 + ...)) with every limb value in the value set. Written by tools/radix_encodings.py, which states the encoding rule.

limb_values.description: The integers of the value set: the values one limb can take.

limb_radius.description: The largest D with every integer in -D..D a limb value.

formula.description: The radius of the k-limb range in terms of k, (base^k - 1) / 3.

residues.description: One row per residue r modulo base, -(base - 1)/2 <= r <= (base - 1)/2.

limb_value.description: The limb value used for r: r itself when it is a limb value, else r - base or r + base.

carry.description: (r - limb_value) / base, added to the next limb.

split.description: When r is not a limb value: two limb values that sum to r, each stored as its own plane for that limb (a plane is one stored operand of a floating-point matrix multiplication).

radius.description: Every integer in -radius..radius is encoded with this many limbs by the rule of tools/radix_encodings.py.

limb_values.description: a0, a1, ... from the lowest limb.

residues.description: The residue modulo base taken at each limb but the top one.

carries.description: The carry each limb but the top one passes to the next.
